title: Finite-free relative tensor coordinates and normalized unitors
statement:
Let $C$ be an essentially small site, and let $H=\operatorname{Sh}(C,\operatorname{Ab})$ have the canonical sheafified tensor over $\mathbf Z$, with sheafification and closed symmetric monoidal structure as in [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. Use internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and the coequalizer relative tensor and its induced monoidal structure [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor]. For any commutative ring object $R$, write $U:\operatorname{Mod}_R(H)\to H$ for the forgetful functor and $t_{P,M}:UP\otimes UM\to U(P\otimes_R M)$ for the canonical coequalizer projection.
Let $R$ be a commutative ring object of $H$, let $N$ be an $R$-module, let $n\geq0$ be an integer, and let $\theta:R^{\oplus n}\xrightarrow{\sim}N$ be an $R$-module isomorphism. Here $R^{\oplus n}$ is the finite biproduct of regular modules, with inclusions $\iota_i$ and projections $\pi_i$; put $e_i=\theta\iota_i:R\to N$ and $q_i=\pi_i\theta^{-1}:N\to R$. Write $\rho_i:M^n\to M$ for the finite-product projections, $L_M:R\otimes_R M\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ for the left unitor of the relative module tensor, $\lambda_{UM}:\mathbf1\otimes UM\xrightarrow{\sim}UM$ for the ambient left unitor, $\eta_R:\mathbf1\to R$ for the ring unit, and $\gamma_M:R\otimes UM\to UM$ for the action. The induced relative unitor has the following normalization in $H$:
$$U(L_M)\circ t_{R,M}=\gamma_M,\qquad U(L_M^{-1})=t_{R,M}\circ(\eta_R\otimes\operatorname{id}_{UM})\circ\lambda_{UM}^{-1}.$$
There is a natural isomorphism of $R$-module valued functors
$$D_\theta:N\otimes_R-\xrightarrow{\sim}(-)^n$$
with the following identities in $\operatorname{Mod}_R(H)$:
$$\rho_iD_{\theta,M}=L_M\circ(q_i\otimes_R\operatorname{id}_M),\qquad D_{\theta,M}^{-1}=\sum_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)}(e_i\otimes_R\operatorname{id}_M)\circ L_M^{-1}\circ\rho_i.$$
On underlying sheaves these identities are normalized by the canonical coequalizer projections:
$$U(\rho_iD_{\theta,M})\circ t_{N,M}=\gamma_M\circ(Uq_i\otimes\operatorname{id}_{UM}),$$
$$U(D_{\theta,M}^{-1})=\sum_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)}t_{N,M}\circ((Ue_i\circ\eta_R)\otimes\operatorname{id}_{UM})\circ\lambda_{UM}^{-1}\circ U\rho_i.$$
For every $R$-linear map $f:M\to M'$ the naturality equation is
$$D_{\theta,M'}\circ(\operatorname{id}_N\otimes_R f)=f^n\circ D_{\theta,M}.$$
All assertions include $n=0$, with empty biproduct, empty product and empty sums. The statements concern the canonical sheaf tensor and relative tensor; they do not identify sections of a tensor sheaf with sectionwise tensors.
